**T23 complete.** `src/core/bignum.ts` (new), the named barrel line in `src/core/index.ts`, and `tests/bignum.test.ts` (7 tests, AC titles verbatim).

Two things worth flagging beyond the task itself:

1. **Root cause of the repeated MERGE_RED is `.gitignore`, not the code.** `node_modules/` and `graphify-out/` carry trailing slashes, so they match directories only — the symlinks dispatch creates in each lane are *not* ignored and show as `??`. Committing them makes the merge overwrite main's real directories with self-referential symlinks. I committed explicit paths and verified `git ls-tree` contains neither. A durable fix (dropping the trailing slashes, or adding the symlinks to `.git/info/exclude` at dispatch) is outside this task's `Files:`, so I left it alone and wrote it up in the session record — but every lane will keep hitting this until someone does it.

2. **The main checkout has no `node_modules` at all.** The revert of iter-02's merge deleted the symlink that had replaced the real directory, so it's gone. The lane symlink was dangling; I replaced it with a real `npm ci` install inside the worktree (which the `node_modules/` pattern *does* correctly ignore). The main checkout will need its own `npm ci` before anything runs there — I did not touch it, per the lane rules.
